coverage_issues: qwen model failed to audit .gitignore due to API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError), resulting in an inconclusive verdict despite no security concerns
learnings: Tool errors (API failures, timeouts) on non-executable files like .gitignore should not trigger an 'inconclusive' package verdict when all executable files (PKGBUILD, .install) are assessed as safe
The audit tool should distinguish between 'inconclusive due to security uncertainty' and 'inconclusive due to tool error' in the final verdict calculation
Non-executable metadata files (.gitignore, .SRCINFO) should be fast-tracked or excluded from LLM review to reduce API failure impact on overall verdict
